completion_criteria: Each claimed limiting trend is supported by at least one refinement axis that does not simultaneously change the physical profile or normalization convention.

Any proposed continuum crossover passes frozen exterior, cross-coupling, spectral, and wavefunction criteria and remains stable under the declared refinement sequence; otherwise no crossover is reported over the tested domain.
